episodes.synopsis: Myne begins her new life as Rosemyne. Her first challenge is to complete the baptism and adoption ceremonies!
episodes.title: I've Become a Noble

episodes.synopsis: After the baptism ceremony and adoption, Rosemyne returns to the cathedral to become the high bishop.
episodes.title: Lower City Family Reunion

episodes.synopsis: Rosemyne officially moves into the castle and Sylvester finally eats at the Italian restaurant.
episodes.title: Archduke's Castle and Italian Restaurant

episodes.synopsis: Rosemyne tries to collect donations from the nobility, but finds it harder than she thought...
episodes.title: How to Collect Donations

episodes.synopsis: Rosemyne puts all her efforts into preparing for the harspiel concert.
episodes.title: Concert Preparations

episodes.synopsis: Everything is falling into place for the concert. All that's left is to guard against one person...
episodes.title: Harspiel Concert

episodes.synopsis: The monastery in Hasse is now ready. Rosemyne goes for the final inspection and to accept new children.
episodes.title: Hasse's Monastery

episodes.synopsis: Ferdinand gives Rosemyne the task to entrap and isolate the mayor of Hasse.
episodes.title: Ferdinand's Task

episodes.synopsis: Rosemyne finally gets fed up with Wilfried's complaints and offers to switch spots with him for a day.
episodes.title: Wilfried's Day as High Bishop

episodes.synopsis: To improve the printing press, Ingo is even willing to exchange ideas between different trades.
episodes.title: The Gathering of Gutenbergs

episodes.synopsis: The winter social season is here and Rosemyne must successfully finish her debut.
episodes.title: The Winter Social Season and Debut

episodes.synopsis: Rosemyne attempts to gather materials for her jureve once again!
episodes.title: Winter Material Gathering

episodes.synopsis: Hasse's punishment has finally been decided and Rosemyne must go to witness the results.
episodes.title: Hasse's Punishment

episodes.synopsis: Rosemyne must go to the Goddess's Bath on the Night of Fruhtrane to collect the spring material for her jureve.
episodes.title: Night of Fruhtrane

episodes.synopsis: Brigitte tries on the dress that Rosemyne designed while the printing press is finally ready for a test print.
episodes.title: New Dress and Printing Press

episodes.synopsis: With the archduke and his wife away, Rozemyne must stay at the castle with Wilfried.
episodes.title: Holding the Fort During the Archduke Conference

episodes.synopsis: The Star-Binding Ceremony begins and Rosemyne hopes Brigitte's new dress will enchant the nobility.
episodes.title: Damuel's Proposal

episodes.synopsis: Rosemyne and her Gutenberg go to Illgner in hopes of finding new materials for papermaking.
episodes.title: Inspection of Illgner and Gathering of Summer

episodes.synopsis: Georgine comes to visit and everyone in Ehrenfest question her true motives.
episodes.title: Georgine's Visit

episodes.synopsis: Rosemyne tries to gather the ruelle fruit once again. This time Ferdinand and Karstedt join to ensure success.
episodes.title: Ruelle Rechallenge

episodes.synopsis: Rosemyne discovers Wilfried's actions and a meeting is convened to determine the truth of the matter.
episodes.title: Wilfried's Actions

episodes.synopsis: Charlotte is officially welcomed to the Archduke's family, but there is danger lurking in the shadows.
episodes.title: Charlotte's Baptism
